Netflix today unveils the trailer for


Love Is Blind: Netherlands


Just one day after revealing the


[30 single men and women](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/netflix-reveals-singles-of-dating-series-love-is-blind-netherlands) , viewers get their first look as they embark on their search for love. Hosted by Nicolette van Dam and Bas Smit,


Love Is Blind: Netherlands


premieres exclusively on Netflix on September 30.


About


Love is Blind: Netherlands


In


Love is Blind: Netherlands


, 30 single men and women enter the pods in the hope of finding a genuine, lasting connection, without ever seeing the person they're talking to. They date in individual pods, separated by a thin wall, and have the chance to build an emotional connection before meeting face-to-face. If they feel they've found the right person, they can even get engaged before seeing each other for the first time. From there, the couples meet in person and find out whether their connection can survive outside the pods. They travel together, move in together, plan their weddings, and navigate the challenges of building a relationship in the real world. And then comes the ultimate test: the altar. Will they say ‘I do’ and prove that love really is blind, or will they decide to go their separate ways?


Batch 1 of the first season of


Love is Blind: Netherlands


premieres September 30. The season consists of 10 episodes, following the singles as they navigate their journey to find love.
